_comment: Pipelines (segments) of MASTER_LEADS. `dir` is where segment_leads.mjs writes the DERIVED per-pipeline file, relative to lead-generation/data/. Dataset directories are fixed; geography is a field, not a folder.

B2C_BROAD.label: B2C Broad
B2C_BROAD.description: Individual prospects with no known current travel requirement.

B2C_INTENT.label: B2C Intent
B2C_INTENT.description: Individuals with publicly observable, recorded travel-related evidence.

B2B_CORPORATE.label: B2B Corporate
B2B_CORPORATE.description: Companies and their relevant contacts (executive, assistant, ops, HR, events, travel, procurement...).

TRAVEL_INDUSTRY.label: Travel Industry
TRAVEL_INDUSTRY.description: Travel agencies, advisors, tour operators, TMCs, planners, concierge/vacation specialists.

CONCIERGE_LUXURY.label: Concierge & Luxury
CONCIERGE_LUXURY.description: Concierge, lifestyle, family-office, private-club, yacht, aviation and luxury businesses.

EVENTS_WEDDINGS.label: Events & Weddings
EVENTS_WEDDINGS.description: Wedding planners, event planners, conference organisers, production companies.

ARTS_CULTURE.label: Arts & Culture
ARTS_CULTURE.description: Museums, galleries, art fairs, opera, performing arts, cultural institutions and foundations.

INSTITUTIONAL.label: Institutional
INSTITUTIONAL.description: Universities, research bodies, associations, international and membership organisations.

CRUISE.label: Cruise
CRUISE.description: Cruise-related prospects and cruise group opportunities.

GROUP_TRAVEL.label: Group Travel
GROUP_TRAVEL.description: Family, friend, corporate, school, cultural, event and wedding groups.

STRATEGIC_PARTNERS.label: Strategic Partners
STRATEGIC_PARTNERS.description: Hotels, DMCs, experience/transport providers and others for partnership, kept apart from direct prospects.
